orders.title: Orders to check
orders.subtitle: Wasel reads what each customer wrote and scores how likely the order is to be refused at the door. Riskiest orders are at the top.
guide: A customer message arrives on WhatsApp, or you paste it.
Wasel scores the refusal risk and explains why, in the customer's own words.
Open an order to confirm with the customer, then ship it.

order.title: Order detail
hints: Highlighted words are what Wasel noticed. Hover or focus a highlight to see why.
Every time the customer writes, Wasel scores the order again.
order.verdict_line: Send the drafted question below, then wait for the customer's answer. Wasel rescores as soon as they reply.

messages.title: WhatsApp messages
messages.subtitle: Messages your customers send to your WhatsApp business number land here within seconds, already scored.

add.title: Add an order
add.subtitle: Paste a customer's message exactly as they wrote it, in Darija, Arabizi, Arabic or French. Wasel scores it in a few seconds.
examples: Arabic script, a neighbour receives it

impact.title: Money saved
impact.subtitle: How much wasted delivery cost Wasel avoids when you follow its advice. This is a simulation on synthetic orders, not real sales.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.subtitle: Everything Wasel did, newest first: messages received, scores, drafted replies and anything that needed attention.

quality.title: Quality checks
quality.subtitle: Before every release, Wasel is tested on hundreds of example conversations. A release only ships when all checks pass.

failures.title: Silent failures
failures.subtitle: A demonstration of the silent-failure analyzer on synthetic test conversations. It is not a measurement of real Wasel conversations.
failures.note: Test data, not real Wasel conversations.

monitor.title: Live monitor
monitor.subtitle: Watches the last messages Wasel scored and warns you if they start to look different from what it was tested on.

traces.title: AI call log
traces.subtitle: Every request Wasel made to an AI model: what it was for, which model answered and how long it took. Customer text is never stored here.

states.error: Could not load this. Check that the Wasel server is running, then refresh the page.
states.offline: Can't reach the Wasel server. Showing the last data received.

rules: Risk tier is never carried by colour alone: name, glyph and colour together.
Customer text uses dir=auto and keeps its original script.
